resolution: Materialized face shaders crashed the compiled world: a face recipe ships only fs_main, the no-V8 loader fed it raw to wgpu which PANICKED (SIGABRT) on missing fbm/U/VsOut. Fixed by extracting the full Effect shader assembly (fixed header + math prelude + recipe), formerly v8_app-only, into a pure shared gpu/effect_assemble.zig that BOTH the V8 host and the no-V8 material path use — one home, no drift. renderShaderToTexture assembles+frees it around pipeline build. Verified: forced-material render proof shows the real brick shader on every face; clean render proof PASS; V8 host (320MB) + world_loader both build clean ReleaseFast.
